description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related HTTP handling in a Node.js/Express application. It includes functions for CORS configuration, security headers via Helmet, and rate limiting, with dynamic configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware function for handling CORS with dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for setting security headers with relaxed Content Security Policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for rate limiting, configurable via environment variables.
